title: Sampo's Song vs Opoki Hundred
lede:
Sampo's Song won 33-26 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5, crossing 30 in the last Cleanup Phase after retaking the centre in Round 4 and the left objective in Round 5.

The objectives and secondaries came out almost level (15 and 10 VP to 14 and 10); the 8-2 Primary decided it, because BREAK THEIR HOLD scored every round from Round 2, which also shut off the 2 VP half of Opoki's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION.
result_line: Sampo's Song win 33-26 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Sampo's Song lined up on row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Nostovaki Militia 2 at (3,12), Vainamoinen leading Nostovaki Militia 1 at (4,12), the Tietaja at (5,12), Nostovaki Militia 3 at (8,12), the Ukko Thunder-Sledge at (9,12), the Erankavijat Recons HIDDEN at (10,12) and the Winter Captain leading the Peijaiset Wardens on the right at (11,12). The Opoki Hundred mirrored it on row 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): Veche Levy 2 at (3,2), Tysyatsky 2 leading the Ushkuynik Marines at (4,2), Veche Levy 1 at (6,2), Tysyatsky 1 leading Koscheyan Troopers 1 at (9,2), Veche Levy 3 at (10,2), Koscheyan Troopers 2 at (11,2) and the Leshen Besieger behind at (9,0). Sampo's Song had Priority (equal units, won the Roll Off). The set-up put both sides' melee squads opposite the centre and one Veche Levy on each Opoki flank. Opoki's identity, Encroaching Winter, spreads its Consumed By Blizzard rows toward Sampo's lines each round; from Round 3 they CHILLED the Sampo units they reached.

1.title: The Thunder-Sledge opens on Veche Levy 1

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for Sampo's Song, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION for the Opoki Hundred. Secondaries kept: BAR THE GATES and KING OF THE HILL. Each side spent 2 of its 3 CP on Double Time, Sampo's Song on the Peijaiset Wardens and Opoki on the Ushkuynik Marines; the record prices both at nothing (the moves were in reach without it).

The Peijaiset Wardens and the Winter Captain advanced 11,12 to 7,8, onto the south edge of the centre. Opoki met them with the Ushkuynik Marines and Tysyatsky 2 at 6,6 and Veche Levy 1 at 7,6; Veche Levy 3 walked onto the right objective at 13,6. Vainamoinen and Nostovaki Militia 1 started for the left at 2,10.

The Ukko Thunder-Sledge's Thunderstone Mortar put 4 of 5 hits on Veche Levy 1, none saved: 8 damage, four Levymen and PARALYZED. The Erankavijat Recons broke HIDDEN to shoot the Ushkuynik Marines for 6 (three of five models), and Nostovaki Militia 3 took 2 more off Veche Levy 1. The Marines' shotguns managed 1 hit on the Wardens, saved.
Sampo's Song took the centre on OC 11 vs 9 (3 VP); Veche Levy 3 held the right alone, OC 10 vs 0 (2 VP). BAR THE GATES completed for Sampo's Song, +2. 5-2.

2.title: The Wardens smash Veche Levy 1, then fail Morale on a 1

feed.text: Opoki spent 4 CP: Double Time on Tysyatsky 2 (bought nothing) and Rally Cry from the HQ (2), which passed the Ushkuynik Marines' Morale Test. Sampo's Song spent 2 on Double Time for Nostovaki Militia 2, which paid off with a move it could not otherwise make. New secondaries: IRON GRIP and SECURE THE FLANKS.

Vainamoinen took Nostovaki Militia 1 into the left objective's area at 0,8 and spent 1 CP on Go to Ground against Veche Levy 2's Overwatch, which still did 4 (2.22 expected HP saved). The Erankavijat Recons walked 9,9 to 13,8, beside Veche Levy 3 on the right objective, and lost a model to its Overwatch. Koscheyan Troopers 2 stepped to 8,6, and the Peijaiset Wardens charged 7,8 to 8,7 into Koscheyan Troopers 2 and Veche Levy 1.

Veche Levy 3 finished the Erankavijat Recons (9 of 18 hits, 4 damage): Recons destroyed, 18 RP, and KING OF THE HILL paid Opoki 3. The Wardens answered with 8 hits and 10 damage: Veche Levy 1 destroyed. Both Tysyatsky used Ring the Advance to walk Koscheyan Troopers 1 to 6,7 and the Ushkuynik Marines to 6,8, into the centre. The Thunder-Sledge put 8 into Veche Levy 2 (PARALYZED) and Vainamoinen 2 more with BURNED; Koscheyan Troopers 1's Madsen guns put 13 of 15 hits on Vainamoinen and 7 damage went through to Nostovaki Militia 1.

The Wardens' Morale Test (2+) came up a natural 1 and left them SUPPRESSED: Opoki took the centre on OC 16 vs 0 (3 VP) and kept the right (2). Sampo's Song held the left on OC 9 vs 4 (2). BREAK THEIR HOLD 1, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 1, and IRON GRIP +2 VP +1 CP for Sampo's Song. 10-11.

3.title: Vainamoinen burns out the Marines; Opoki hold the centre

feed.text: Sampo's Song kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (Opoki picked the centre for it) and spent 4 CP: Double Time on Nostovaki Militia 3 and Rally Cry from the Winter Captain for the Wardens. Opoki kept INTO THE FRAY and spent 2 on Double Time for the Ushkuynik Marines. Consumed By Blizzard CHILLED the Winter Captain and the Wardens; Veche Levy 2 failed Morale on a 1 and was SUPPRESSED.

The Ushkuynik Marines and Tysyatsky 2 ran 6,8 to 2,8, on the enemy side near the west edge, for SECURE THE FLANKS, with an Overwatch for 2 on Nostovaki Militia 3 on the way. Nostovaki Militia 3 came back from 11,10 to 8,8 and Nostovaki Militia 2 to 7,9. The Leshen Besieger's Overwatch missed and it set Earthfast Stance (MOVE 0, +2 RANGE, +1 FR).

The Wardens hit Koscheyan Troopers 2 for 6 (two models) and took 4. Koscheyan Troopers 1's Madsen guns hit Nostovaki Militia 3 15 times out of 15: 12 damage, six models. The Thunder-Sledge took 6 off Koscheyan Troopers 1 and PARALYZED it and Tysyatsky 1. Vainamoinen's Sun Sword of Ilmarinen hit 4 of 4: Ushkuynik Marines destroyed, Tysyatsky 2 BURNED. The Leshen Besieger hit Nostovaki Militia 2 for 6. Both Tysyatsky used The Bell Carries; neither use bought anything.
Opoki kept the centre on OC 15 vs 12 and the right on 16 vs 0 (5 VP); Sampo's Song the left on 8 vs 2 (2). BREAK THEIR HOLD 1; SECURE THE FLANKS +2 VP +1 CP for Opoki through Tysyatsky 2. 13-18.

4.title: The Wardens charge back into the centre

feed.text: Opoki had Priority (fewer units, 8 to 9). It spent 4 CP: Double Time on Koscheyan Troopers 2 and Rally Cry from Tysyatsky 2 for Veche Levy 2. Sampo's Song spent 3 on Secure Objective for the Wardens, which bought nothing. Secondaries kept: FORWARD PRESENCE and ASSASSINATION. Consumed By Blizzard CHILLED six Sampo units, and Nostovaki Militia 1 failed Morale (3 on a 4+) and was SUPPRESSED.

Koscheyan Troopers 2 fell back from the Wardens to 5,4, failed its FALL BACK TEST on a 1 and lost a model to 3 True Damage. Veche Levy 3 left the uncontested right objective, 12,6 to 9,6. Tysyatsky 2 charged Vainamoinen and Nostovaki Militia 1 at 1,8 (INTO THE FRAY, +2), and the Wardens and Winter Captain charged 8,7 to 6,6 into Tysyatsky 1, Koscheyan Troopers 1 and Veche Levy 2.

Koscheyan Troopers 1 struck at the Winter Captain and was met by counterattacks from him and the Wardens: 4 damage, two models, and no hits back. Tysyatsky 1 put 2 into the Wardens; Tysyatsky 2's counterattack did 2 to Nostovaki Militia 1 while Vainamoinen missed. The Thunder-Sledge PARALYZED Veche Levy 3 for 1 damage.

Sampo's Song retook the centre on OC 11 vs 5 (3 VP). Tysyatsky 2 took the left on OC 3 vs 0, Nostovaki Militia 1 being SUPPRESSED (2 VP). Nobody held the right. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the centre Opoki had held at the start of the round, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 1, and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET +3. 22-23.

5.title: Secure Objective holds the left and Sampo's Song pass 30

feed.text: Both sides kept DEEP REACH. Opoki spent 4 CP: Double Time on Koscheyan Troopers 2 and Rally Cry from Tysyatsky 1 for Koscheyan Troopers 1. Sampo's Song spent 3 on Secure Objective for Nostovaki Militia 1, and this one decided 2 VP. Nostovaki Militia 1 passed its Morale Test this time.

Koscheyan Troopers 2 doubled back 5,4 to 2,6 into the left objective's area. Veche Levy 2 fell back from the Wardens to 4,6 and also failed its test (3 True Damage, a model). Veche Levy 3 stepped to 8,6 and took 4 from Nostovaki Militia 2's Overwatch, and Nostovaki Militia 2 charged 5,9 to 6,8 into Tysyatsky 1 and Koscheyan Troopers 1.

Tysyatsky 1 hit Nostovaki Militia 2 for 4 after taking a counterattack (1 damage to Koscheyan Troopers 1). The Wardens rolled four hits on the last Koscheyan Trooper: Koscheyan Troopers 1 destroyed, 40 RP. Tysyatsky 2 did 2 to Nostovaki Militia 1 and the Thunder-Sledge 4 to Veche Levy 3.

Sampo's Song held the centre on OC 12 vs 9 and the left on 9 vs 7, the Secure Objective margin (5 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 for the left took them to 30, DEEP REACH +3. Opoki's DEEP REACH also paid 3 although it controlled no objective at the scoring. 33-26, Sampo's Song past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Sampo's Song scored 15 VP from objectives, 8 from BREAK THEIR HOLD and 10 from secondaries (BAR THE GATES 2, IRON GRIP 2, TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3, DEEP REACH 3). The Opoki Hundred scored 14 from objectives, 2 from STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION and 10 from secondaries (KING OF THE HILL 3, SECURE THE FLANKS 2, INTO THE FRAY 2, DEEP REACH 3). The 7-point margin is the Primary gap and nothing else. BREAK THEIR HOLD pays whenever Sampo's Song stands in an objective the enemy holds, so it paid 1 in Rounds 2 and 3 while Opoki held the centre with the Wardens inside it, then 3 in each of Rounds 4 and 5 as the centre and the left changed hands. STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION's 2 VP half needs the opponent's Primary to score nothing in the round; that never happened after Round 1, and its 1 VP half paid only in Round 2 (the Wardens SUPPRESSED in the centre) and Round 4 (Nostovaki Militia 1 SUPPRESSED on the left).

Opoki's last 3 VP look like an engine slip. Its DEEP REACH paid in Round 5 although every objective is 6 squares from its HQ and it controlled none of them at the scoring (the centre went 12 vs 9 and the left 9 vs 7 to Sampo's Song, the right was empty). The left was Sampo's only through the Secure Objective on Nostovaki Militia 1, and the round-end secondary check appears to run after the Cleanup Phase expires this-round modifiers, when Tysyatsky 2 and Koscheyan Troopers 2 would out-hold it on (1,7). It did not change the winner.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Peijaiset Wardens were the battle: 12.4 VP of fair share (7.5 objective, 4.0 missions), 9 objective VP hinged on them, 22 damage and both of their side's melee kills, Veche Levy 1 in Round 2 and Koscheyan Troopers 1 in Round 5. The Ukko Thunder-Sledge did the most damage on the table, 27 for 30 RP (0.90 per RP), firing every round and leaving a PARALYZED target each time it hit. Nostovaki Militia 1 and Vainamoinen held the left for 6.3 and 4.3 VP; Vainamoinen did 6 damage for 70 RP, the Ushkuynik Marines its one kill.

For Opoki, Veche Levy 3 was the best value, 9.3 VP for 15 RP (62.2 per 100 RP): the right objective for three rounds and the Recons kill that paid KING OF THE HILL. Tysyatsky 2 scored 7.5 VP, mostly secondaries (SECURE THE FLANKS, INTO THE FRAY) and the left objective in Round 4. Koscheyan Troopers 1 did 19 damage and was the only Opoki unit to do more than 6.

{{chart:attrition}}

What Opoki could not do

It could not keep the centre once the Wardens were back on their feet. Opoki held it in Rounds 2 and 3 only because the Wardens were SUPPRESSED or outnumbered (16 vs 0, then 15 vs 12); in Round 4 Koscheyan Troopers 2 fell back from them, their charge to 6,6 and counterattacks took Koscheyan Troopers 1 down to one model, and the centre went 11 vs 5. Opoki lost 85 RP (Veche Levy 1, the Ushkuynik Marines, Koscheyan Troopers 1) to Sampo's 18 (the Recons).

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • The Tietaja did nothing in five rounds. Its only Mana action, Raise Luonto, requires the caster not to have moved that Battle Round, and the AI moved it in every Movement Phase (5,12 to 3,10, 1,10, 1,13, 0,12 and 1,11). The activity record has it idle with no legal action all five rounds, and Sampo's Song finished with 0 Mana: Vainamoinen never cast either.
  • Round 4, Veche Levy 3 walked off the right objective (12,6 to 9,6) with no Sampo unit near it, then shot Nostovaki Militia 3 for nothing. Opoki scored no objective on the right in Rounds 4 and 5: 4 VP given away.
  • The Leshen Besieger (45 RP) shuffled 5,3 to 7,2 to 5,0 to 7,2, was idle with no legal action in four rounds, and did 6 damage in all.
  • Round 2, the Erankavijat Recons walked from 9,9 to 13,8, next to Veche Levy 3, and died to its Overwatch and shots; the kill paid Opoki KING OF THE HILL.
  • Double Time bought nothing three times (both sides in Round 1, Opoki in Round 2), and the two uses of The Bell Carries bought nothing.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes. Four of its 13 "stayed" entries name engagers that were never adjacent when the unit could act: Round 2 Ushkuynik Marines (held) and Veche Levy 1 ("should have left": the Wardens charged it after Opoki had passed its Movement Phase, and it was PARALYZED), Round 3 Nostovaki Militia 1 (Veche Levy 2 two squares away) and Round 4 Nostovaki Militia 3 ("risky hold" against the Leshen Besieger at 5,0). The two real Fall Backs, Koscheyan Troopers 2 in Round 4 and Veche Levy 2 in Round 5, were rated sound; both failed the FALL BACK TEST for 3 True Damage.

The result looks mostly like the matchup: both armies scored the same objective and secondary VP, and Sampo's Primary fitted a centre that changed hands. The AI's clearest cost was Opoki's walk off the right objective in Round 4, 4 VP of a 7 VP margin; on Sampo's side it wasted the Tietaja and with it every spell the army had.

closing: A level fight over three objectives went to the side whose Primary paid for contesting them: the Peijaiset Wardens sat in the centre whoever held it, and BREAK THEIR HOLD turned that into 8 VP. The Opoki Hundred matched Sampo's Song everywhere else, then gave up its right flank in the last two rounds.
